shortDescription: Altunc Kumova, a discreet businessman who became one of Turkey’s richest people after a meteoric rise in his finance firm’s stock, has seen $4 billion erased from his fortune, according to Bloomberg.The decline follows a rout in his Turkey fund.

title: Turkey Fund Slump Wipes Out $4 Billion of Altunc Kumova’s Fortune
